final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT o.timespan, AVG(f.rebrate / f.feerate) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink GROUP BY o.timespan), overall AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM grouped), kept AS (SELECT g.avg_ratio, g.record_count, g.record_count - a.avg_count AS count_diff FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS a WHERE a.avg_count IS NOT NULL AND g.record_count > a.avg_count) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio), SUM(record_count), AVG(count_diff) FROM kept
